query: For a 56-year-old male, among males aged 51–61 in the ICU, what's the SD of first recorded respiratory rate?
final_sql: SELECT stddev(o.value) AS standard_deviation FROM omr o JOIN patients p ON o.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN icustays i ON o.subject_id = i.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age = 56 AND i.first_careunit = 'ICU' AND p.anchor_year BETWEEN 51 AND 61;
